title: What is a webhook? Explained for non-developers | 50agents
description: A webhook is a web address one app calls the moment something happens, sending the details, so another app can act straight away. Explained plainly.
definition: A webhook is a web address one app calls the moment something happens, sending the details so another app can act.
Apps push news this way instead of asking "anything new?" every few minutes.
